# Wiki Article Template

> **How to use this template:**
> 1. Copy this file to the appropriate docs subfolder (e.g., `docs/wiki/backend/`)
> 2. Rename the file following the pattern: `WIKI<date>-<short-description>.md`
>    - Example: `WIKI202605271230-deployment-process.md`
> 3. Fill in each section below with article content
> 4. Delete this instruction block when done
> 
> **Wiki article guidelines:**
> - Keep sections concise but informative
> - Use headings, bullet points, and code blocks for readability
> - Include links to related documentation
> - Update the "Last updated" field whenever changes are made

---
